summary: Check whether the integrated local repository state is ready to push.

evidence: User asks whether they can push.
intervals.description: Inspect current branch, tracking divergence, and working-tree state to advise on pushing.

results: Confirmed main is two commits behind cached origin/main and the working tree remains dirty with both previous edits and uncommitted upstream integration.
open_items: Decide which existing local modifications may be committed; a commit is needed before the branch can be rebased and pushed.
limitations: No commit or push was made because the current changes include substantial pre-existing work and the user has not specified commit scope.
